name: the beach
title: A Grey Beach
description: wet sand, broken shells, a line of wrack.

explore.name: look around
nothingLog: you walk the shore again. nothing new.

text: grey sand runs both ways until it bends out of sight. wrack and broken shells mark the tide line.
behind the dunes the trees begin. a forest, close and hard to miss.
at the far end of the beach, a ring of rocks breaks the sea wind.
you could light a fire here, if you find some wood.
past the rocks, a low cliff drops into the surf. shells cling to the wet stone below it.
you could pick them and eat them as they are. cooked, they would go further.
in the shallows, a school of small fish turns and flashes.
too quick for bare hands. with a sharp stick you might spear one.

activities.name: light fire
activities.log: a spark, a curl of smoke. the fire takes.

activities.name: collect shells
log: you prise shells off the wet stone. the surf soaks your legs.
a handful of shells, cold and heavy.

activities.name: cook shells
activities.log: the shell pops open in the embers.

activities.name: make a spear
activities.log: you grind a straight branch to a point against the rocks.

activities.name: catch fish

outcomes.text: two fish, flapping on the sand.
nothing. the fish are quicker than you.

activities.log: you wade into the shallows, spear raised.

activities.name: cook fish
activities.log: the fish hisses on a flat stone by the fire.

activities.name: sleep
activities.requiresText: too cold and dark to sleep without a fire

outcomes.text: you wake in the dark. the surf is loud.

activities.log: you curl up by the fire and sleep.
